actions: Loosen the intake hose band clamp
Remove the two airbox mounting fasteners

elements.describe: The large black plastic air filter housing in the engine bay, sitting on a lower rubber stud.
Two fasteners (reported 10 mm) holding the airbox to the car near the fender.
A round metal band clamp where the rubber intake hose meets the airbox.
A small plug on the mass airflow sensor with a lift-up retention clip that is brittle.
Two plastic retention tabs that hold the front intake snorkel to the airbox.
